motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Chief Legislative Analyst be instructed to report on the impacts of the Mayor’s proposed Capital Infrastructure Plan (C.F. 26-0758) and the Bureau of Engineering’s proposed capital project intake process (C.F. 25-0752), including the Plan’s potential impacts on the Council’s ability to initiate, prioritize, and fund capital projects. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Administrative Officer, and other departments as necessary, be instructed to report on the how the proposed Capital Infrastructure Plan and capital project intake process would impact the City’s budget process, including impacts to the annual Capital and Technology Improvement Expenditure Plan, funding sources that support capital projects, as well as how the proposed Plan would impact the management and oversight of capital projects and city facility maintenance, including potential delays to or elimination of current and pending projects and annual work programs. PRESENTED BY: /^^^^^ IMELDA PADILLA Councilmember, 6th District SECONDED BY: Doula AUG 2 1 2026
title: Proposed Capital Infrastructure Plan / Capital and Technology Improvement Expenditure Program / Bureau of Engineering / Capital Project Intake Process / Study Potential Impact
